tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon data are consistent with the stated endogenous dual-horizon adaptation candidate, but do not constrain its slow component. A long-horizon discriminating probe is needed before fitting and confirming a model against the required forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations are all at H ≤ 0.48 and only show short-window positive gain; they cannot identify the slow adaptation timescale or confirm reversal near the target horizon H=19.9.
The observations do not indicate a coupled-memory ODE; the explicit signature and long-horizon target make a slow-horizon measurement more discriminating and less costly.
Nuisance auxiliary measurements do not resolve the relevant horizon ambiguity and are expressly unnecessary.
